    Add tests for circular dependency resolution safety
    
    Cover transitive_dependents and compute_skips behavior on
    graphs with circular references (two-node, three-node, and
    self-cycles) to verify the visited-set guard prevents
    infinite loops. Also add tests for accessor edge cases
    (unknown steps, empty graphs, partial dependency readiness,
    builder accumulation, and SkipBehavior default).
